title: Polynomial model of the single-chart zero-base quotient
statement: Let R and Cbar be commutative rings, pi in R and R2=R/(pi^2). Let d be polynomial data as in [lem-weil-pbc-popescu-lift-preparation]: Q=R[x_i,z_l], u_l=f_l-pi*z_l and p_kl=a_k*z_l-sum_{j in E_k}h_klj*z_j-pi*g_kl. Put A=R2[x_i]/(reduced(f_l)), and ak the image of reduced(a_k) in A. Fix k in Fin(r). Define J_k=(u_l for all l, p_kl for all l) in Q and T_k=ULift(Q/J_k). For a commutative R-algebra B killing pi, put t=1 tensor the class of a_k in B tensor_R T_k. Localizations mean [def-weil-pbc-module-localization-away]. Assume the normalized coefficients h_klj=a_k*delta_lj when l is in E_k; assume compatible R2-algebra structure on B. Then the B-algebra MvPolynomial(E_k, B tensor_R2 A[1/ak]) is isomorphic to (B tensor_R T_k)[1/t]. No preparation, conormal basis, cleared f-relation, smoothness or differential-basis hypothesis is imposed.

proof.text: Tensor the explicitly presented single-chart quotient with B. Since pi=0 in B, u_l becomes f_l for every l and p_kl becomes a_k*z_l-sum h_klj*z_j. Quotient universal properties identify the original-variable coefficient ring with B tensor_R2 A, since coefficient reduction modulo pi squared is invisible in B.

proof.text: Invert a_k. Localization commutes with scalar extension by its universal property: both rings represent maps out of B tensor_R2 A making the image of ak a unit. The coefficient ring is therefore K=B tensor_R2 A[1/ak].

proof.text: Normalization of h makes p_kl identically zero for l in E_k. For every l outside E_k solve z_l=a_k inverse times sum_{j in E_k}h_klj*z_j. The map from K[z_j:j in E_k] sends each free variable to its quotient class; the reverse sends each original coefficient to itself, each free z_j to X_j, and each complementary z_l to the displayed sum. Check the remaining equations by substitution. Check both compositions on coefficients and all z_l; polynomial and quotient extensionality make them inverse. Transport ULift through its algebra equivalence.

lean.statement:
theorem zero_base_single_chart_polynomial (R : Type a) (Cbar : Type c)
    [CommRing R] [CommRing Cbar] (π : R)
    [Algebra (R ⧸ Ideal.span ({π ^ 2} : Set R)) Cbar]
    (d : PopescuLiftPresentation R Cbar π)
    (hnorm : ∀ (k : Fin d.r) (l : Fin d.m), l ∈ d.E k →
      ∀ j : Fin d.m, d.h k l j = if l = j then d.a k else 0)
    (B : Type b) [CommRing B] [Algebra R B]
    [Algebra (R ⧸ Ideal.span ({π ^ 2} : Set R)) B]
    [IsScalarTower R (R ⧸ Ideal.span ({π ^ 2} : Set R)) B]
    (hπ : algebraMap R B π = 0) (k : Fin d.r) :
    let J : Ideal d.polynomial := Ideal.span (Set.range (fun i : Fin d.m ⊕ Fin d.m ↦
      match i with
      | .inl j => d.equation (.inl j)
      | .inr l => d.equation (.inr (k, l))))
    Nonempty (MvPolynomial (d.E k)
      (B ⊗[R ⧸ Ideal.span ({π ^ 2} : Set R)]
        Localization.Away (d.reducedElement k)) ≃ₐ[B]
      Localization.Away (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight (R := R) (A := B)
        (ULift.up (Ideal.Quotient.mk J (d.includeX (d.a k))))))
